paragraphs: In Ketubot 6a he reports in Rav's name. But in Shabbat 111a the statement is attributed to Rav Shimi bar Chiya, a grandson of Rav; Bekhorot 25a reads Rav Chiya bar Ashi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The frozen source is a four-line continuation without its own written heading; the current display title Rav Shimi bar Chizkiyah is inherited context, not a title/name span supplied by this fragment. The fragment actually starts in Ketubot, not but; however אך explicitly introduces the Shabbat contrast and is preserved. The first reporter is grammatically implicit. ו./קיא./כה. give 6a/111a/25a by convention without new checks.

Hyman’s parenthetical grandson-of-Rav qualifies Shimi bar Chiya, not a new merged identity with the display heading or Chiya bar Ashi. גרס reports a reading without specifying an edition. Full Rav is supplied for the quoted authority, Shimi, grandson’s ancestor and Chiya; no extra title goes to either patronymic Chiya/Ashi.
